items.question: How many volunteer categories does the Volunteer Department at the UAE Red Crescent Authority divide its members into?
items.gold: Three categories: Student Crescent, University Crescent and Volunteers.
items.fact: Red Crescent Volunteer Department has three member categories

items.question: Which government body is the Dubai Volunteering Center an initiative of?
items.fact: Dubai Volunteering Center is an initiative by Community Development Authority
